reviews.notes: Severely contaminated domain: labelled Motorsport Engineering but ~two-thirds of rows are generic manufacturing/electronics/production-supervision ESCO fan-out (all ISCO 3122 supervisor variants and 3114 technician variants) with zero motorsport specificity. 6 aka=NaN junk SOC group rows removed. Genuinely relevant roles retained: powertrain engineer, aerodynamics engineer, automotive engineer, engine designer, mechanical engineer, tooling engineer, welding engineer, mechatronics engineer, aerospace engineer, fluid power engineer, precision engineer, software developer. The many production-supervisor/assembly-technician rows listed in overfanout are borderline manufacturing-adjacent but not motorsport-defining; flagged for consolidation rather than mass removal. Domain critically lacked its signature roles (race engineer, vehicle dynamics engineer, composites engineer), now added.
